title: MV "Beyond Love" (Demo): A narrative focused game about mistery.

posts.author: MatidiaRM
posts.body:
[GAME LINK]
DOWNLOAD HERE
[SYNOPSIS]
On a typical Monday, teacher Sabrina informs her students that their classmate Eric has disappeared, which means that the school schedule will undergo major changes.
Amy, an ordinary young student, is shocked by the news, along with her classmates. Determined to find out the truth, Amy will investigate further to discover what really happened to Eric.
In her adventure, Amy will do everything she can to find her classmate, facing various challenges and learning more about her gift.
[ABOUT THE GAME]
Beyond Love is a narrative-driven game with some crucial moments that require the player to choose the right option, otherwise the game will end.
The game has 1 chapter for now (Playing time: Approximately 20 -30 minutes).
